title: Descending pyramid
opening: Two training logs can use the same number for different work. Read what each count includes before comparing the sessions.

modes.label: Three conventional sets
modes.description: This sample uses conventional sets. The picture shows one representative set; the record lists no loads, repetitions, effort or recovery.

modes.label: Three descending pyramids
modes.description: A later, lighter setting can still feel demanding because fatigue carries through the descent.
modes.unitLabel: One complete descent is one pyramid and one continuous set; the “3” counts three such descents.

examples.summary: Record the rungs or loads, repetitions and effort inside each unit. Add the recovery that followed so the sessions can be compared by the work they contain.
